How to suggest a game

Show up to the stream and type it in Twitch chat — the game (from the shelf above) plus a challenge idea if you've got one. Open nights and variety slots get filled from chat picks, and the best rules become full HOUSE RULES trials.

!suggest [game from shelf] — [your challenge idea]
